Title: Can you choose to burn rather than prevent destruction?

Messages.Author: pimp...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Can you choose to let your vampire burn, rather than prevent destruction by
paying blood for aggravated damage?

ie. I mindrape Democritus, when I get control of him I have him bleed with a
daring the dawn (inferior) the first point of agg sends him to torpor, even
though he may have blood on him I would prefer to let him burn from the
second point of agg. Is this legal?

Thanks
